name: Petite Pousse
source:
William is an android who has always been obedient to his creator, Aloïs. Looking after his creator's daughter, Héléna, has always been his duty. The only thing of his own is his love for plants. Apart from that, he never left the family nest, until a deviation from his routine took him to a new world where he could fly the nest.
